title: Back Office Executive
summary: A back office executive does the non-customer-facing processing work in a bank, insurer, broker, BPO or e-commerce company: entering and checking data, scrutinising forms and documents, and preparing MIS reports. They work in an operations team to turnaround time (TAT) and accuracy targets set in a written procedure (SOP).
dailyDuties: Enter and verify customer and transaction data in the core system
Check account opening forms, proposals or KYC documents against the SOP
Raise and track discrepancies with branches or internal teams
Prepare daily MIS reports on volumes, pending cases and TAT
Update client master records and upload documents to registries
Meet daily accuracy and turnaround targets in rotational shifts

skills.expectation: Enter and check customer and transaction data quickly and accurately
Scrutinise forms and supporting documents against the SOP
Prepare daily and weekly MIS reports on volumes, pendencies and TAT
Keep trackers in Excel with formulas, sorting and filters
Use VLOOKUP and pivot tables for MIS reports
Meet turnaround time and accuracy targets for each case
Write clear emails to internal teams about pending documents
Check KYC documents for account opening or policy issuance
Know basic banking, insurance or broking products and processes
Match records between systems and flag differences
Post simple entries where the back office also handles accounts

certifications.why: Shows Excel skill for MIS work
Back-office posts that include bookkeeping often list Tally.
